description: This file contains an implementation of the pixelmatch image comparison algorithm, including functions for pixel data analysis, anti-aliasing detection, and color difference calculation, along with license information.

methods.name: pixelmatch
methods.description: Main function to compare two images and output the difference count.

methods.name: isPixelData
methods.description: Checks if an array is valid pixel data.

methods.name: antialiased
methods.description: Detects if a pixel is part of anti-aliasing.

methods.name: hasManySiblings
methods.description: Checks if a pixel has multiple adjacent pixels of the same color.

methods.name: colorDelta
methods.description: Calculates perceived color difference between two pixels.

methods.name: rgb2i
methods.description: Converts RGB to I component in YIQ color space.

methods.name: rgb2q
methods.description: Converts RGB to Q component in YIQ color space.

methods.name: drawPixel
methods.description: Draws a pixel with specified RGB values.

methods.name: drawGrayPixel
methods.description: Draws a grayscale pixel based on luminance.
